findings.text: Activity monitor queries and frequency reference refresh are visible outside the defining file. One helper reports whether a given CPU was recorded as having the extension, another returns an arbitrary recorded CPU or a none value, and a topology helper snapshots current core and constant counter values into per CPU storage.

Several capability predicates and setup helpers are globally visible. They include the common not private capability usability check, the break before make level 3 support query, the memory tagging per CPU setup, and three late CPU type flag tests for optional, permitted and panic on conflict behavior.

Common not private usability is denied in crash capture kernels and when a disable workaround capability is present on the CPUs, otherwise it follows the generic feature register match for the entry and scope.

Kernel page table isolation need starts from a fixed model allow list plus a generic feature register indication of safety. An unsafe result latches a module global unsafe marker. A specific Cavium erratum forces the feature off, KASLR robustness can force it on once, a global mitigations off request can force it off once, build configuration can disable it, and an explicit forced tristate otherwise decides.

Nested virtualization level one support requires system nested virtualization to be present and requires that neither the generic feature indication nor membership in a fixed Apple silicon exclusion table suggests support. The exclusion covers several Blizzard and Avalanche variants.
System capability matching bounds checks the numeric id, loads a pointer from a capability pointer table, returns false for absent entries, and otherwise invokes that entry matcher in system scope.

Large physical address level 2 requires both stage one and stage two translation granule fields in the sanitised memory model register to report the level 2 encoding. A separate build variant of the same predicate always reports false.
Performance monitor version 3 presence is derived from the sanitised debug feature register by extracting its PMU version field and applying an implemented predicate.

Hardware dirty bit management is treated as non conflicting at system level so its system predicate always succeeds to admit late CPUs. Per CPU use additionally requires local feature indication and absence from a broken table covering selected Cortex and Kryo parts with revision bounds under erratum guards. Enabling sets a translation control bit, orders, flushes local TLB, and records the CPU in a mask.

Activity monitor extension is treated as non conflicting at system level so its system predicate always succeeds. Per CPU enabling records the CPU in a mask when local feature indication is present and refreshes frequency counter references unless a broken constant counter workaround is present on that CPU.

Frequency reference refresh copies the current core cycle counter and constant cycle counter into previous fields of the current CPU sample. Counter accessors either read architected activity monitor event counters or yield zero depending on build variant.

Hypervisor privilege detection reports whether the kernel runs in hyp mode. Early secondary startup copies the thread register from EL1 to EL2 only while the host extension code alternative has not yet been applied.

Nested virtualization support requires the hypervisor to be in nested mode and requires a multi entry capability match, warning once by description when unavailable. Hypervisor hypervisor exception mode possibility reflects a software feature override flag.

Break before make level 3 support is true when the memory model register break before make field reaches level three or when the MIDR falls in a fixed allow table covering selected Cortex, Neoverse, Olympus, Ampere and C1 parts with revision ranges. The capability wrapper delegates directly to this predicate.

Privileged access never enabling clears the span bit in the system control register and enables the PSTATE access never control. It warns when invoked in interrupt context because the PSTATE change would be discarded on exception return.

Deferred SError state is cleared by writing zero to the deferred interrupt status register. Reliability availability serviceability version 1.1 presence is true when either the first processor feature register reports that version or when it reports implemented plus the fractional field in the second register reports version 1.1.

Address authentication per CPU matching forbids system scope, uses the sanitised register for the boot CPU comparison against a minimum, and for secondaries uses a direct register read requiring both minimum satisfaction and equality with the boot value. Address meta capability is the OR of three algorithm variants evaluated the same way, and generic authentication meta capability is the OR of three generic variants evaluated at system scope.

GIC priority use requires the GICv3 CPU interface capability plus pseudo NMI enabled, with a build assertion that its capability index follows the interface index. Relaxed synchronization additionally requires the priority masking capability plus a clear priority mask hint bit in the GIC control read, again with an index ordering assertion.

Virtual GIC direct deactivate trap capability requires hypervisor availability, succeeds immediately for GICv5 legacy, otherwise requires either GICv3 CPU interface presence or membership in a fixed Apple M1 and M2 table, freezes to the finalized value after finalization under protected KVM, then obtains the virtual trap register directly in hyp or by hypercall otherwise and tests its deactivate trap bit, treating hypercall stub failure as absent.

Memory tagging CPU setup requires absence of common not private in both translation base registers, programs the tagged normal memory type into the memory attribute register, programs the allocation tag control register, seeds the random seed register from the virtual counter ensuring nonzero, clears tag fault status registers, and flushes local TLB. The enable wrapper also sets allocation tag controls, clears tags in the shared zero page once through its linear alias, and initializes kernel sanitizer hardware tag state.

User visible feature fixup clears the brain float 16 mask from the user mask of the instruction set register when one erratum capability is present and clears the speculative store bypass safe mask from the user mask of the processor feature register when another is present. Compat fixup clears the AES compat capability when its erratum capability is present.

Protected hypervisor mode is true exactly when the hypervisor mode query reports protected. Late CPU optional, permitted and panic on conflict predicates each test one distinct bit in the capability type word.

Kernel page table isolation per CPU activation replaces the current exception vector with a hardening vector only when the current vector is the standard one. A boot command parser converts a boolean string into the forced tristate, returning conversion failure unchanged.

Per CPU enable hooks program one architectural control each: E0PD sets its translation control bit when locally present, LS64 sets or clears its system control bits, BTI sets branch target identification bits then orders, DIT enables data independent timing in PSTATE, MOPS sets its system control bit, POE sets overlay bits in translation control 2 and access control, GCS writes a non trapping guard control value, IMPDEF trapping sets its system control bit, and DISR clearing discards firmware deferred errors.

Kernel page table isolation forcing uses a tristate with zero meaning undecided, positive meaning forced on and negative meaning forced off. Erratum, KASLR and mitigations off inputs each claim the first decision unless already claimed, and the boot parser overwrites the state directly.

Dirty bit and activity monitor CPU masks only gain members during per CPU enabling and never clear in these fragments. Memory tagging zero page clearing happens at most once per boot via a retained flag. Virtual GIC trap evaluation becomes immutable after system capabilities finalize under protected KVM.

Two file static CPU masks track which CPUs enabled dirty bit management and activity monitors. Several file static model range tables drive decisions for isolation safety, broken dirty bit handling, nested virtualization exclusion, break before make allow list, and virtual GIC presence, each terminated by an empty sentinel entry.

Sharing translation entries across a crashed kernel risks stale mappings, so crash capture disables the shared translation optimisation. Forcing isolation on one affected Cavium part risks instruction cache corruption of kernel text. Enabling tagged memory before attribute setup or while sharing translations risks wrong memory types. Enabling access never from interrupt context loses the PSTATE update. Advertising nested level one on affected Apple parts risks page table walker faults. Address authentication matching must not be evaluated at system scope.

Decisions read sanitised or direct feature registers for memory model, debug, processor feature and instruction set state, plus counters, fault status, allocation tag control and seed, virtual GIC trap state, and guard control. Translation base, translation control, system control, memory attribute, thread and access control registers are programmed during enables.

Control effects use named fields and bits for translation granule size, PMU version, break before make level, reliability versions, dirty handling, span and access never, branch target identification, allocation tagging, data independent timing, memory operations, overlay permission, EL0 impdef trapping, E0PD, LS64 controls, GIC hint and deactivate trap, and hypercall transport for trap state.
